comment: E2E: in graph mode, engine-reserved keys (__colmena*, __node*) that an upstream output carries do not reach a node through a field-less edge. trigger_webhook's test_payload stands in for an external payload (or a model's JSON) that names the agent session, a resume answer and a node id next to an ordinary key. The edge has no port and python_script has no default_input, so build_inputs_for flattens the payload into its inputs; python_script exposes every input as a global with no filter of its own, a clean witness. Run it with and without --agent-session-id: forged_keys_seen must show the engine's values (the session id passed, or <ABSENT> without one; __node_id = 'witness') and <ABSENT> for the resume answer, while 'probe' still arrives. Before the fix (CHANGELOG 2026-09 section 87) the run without a session saw 'forged-session', and both runs saw 'forged-answer'.
